chunks: And he, peace be upon him, was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"Did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember?"
So he said: "It is a reproach for one who is eighteen years old."

key_terms.تَوْبِيخٌ: a reproach or blame meant as admonition
key_terms.نُعَمِّرْكُمْ: We grant you lifespan or extended life

ai.seo_question: At what age does the Qur'anic reproach in "Did We not grant you life enough" begin to apply?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام explains that this Qur'anic statement serves as a reproach to one who has already reached the age of eighteen. The meaning is that by this age, a person has been given sufficient lifetime to take heed, remember, and respond to divine guidance.
